objective: Technical transport of frozen MP36 genotype rules to a distinct HG005 sequencing acquisition on the exact same64 test loci, with local adjudication and nested evidence retained.
selection: Exact64 MP36 test loci and benchmark labels, no replacements, new genotype selection or outcome-dependent exclusions. This is new-acquisition validation at known loci, not new-locus or independent-individual validation.
source_admission: Verify sample/flowcell metadata, CRAM chr20 length and reference MD5. Preserve published CRAI; if header offsets disagree, derive a single header-size shift, check first/second and chr20 containers independently and require successful integrity-checked decoding. No assumed reuse of previous -186 shift.
reads: Same MAPQ20, primary, nonduplicate/nonQCfail, mapped query anchor,300 observed ACGT bases and nested150nt. Exclude every read ID retained in MP36 calibration or test before ranking. Hash-rank IDs, retain at most20, minimum10/site. Preserve non-evaluable sites and all exclusions.
rules: No recalibration. Median relative cutoff0 at150/300nt. Consensus>=80% at relative cutoff0 and4 with absolute admission59/118. Also median cutoff0 with>=80% absolute-admission guard. Same candidates, retained observations and event. Raw signed score preferences, ties, absolute failure and complete allele sets retained.
primary: At300nt, separately assess frozen median0 and strict consensus0 against transported consensus4: more concordant singleton loci, no increase in discordant locus calls, at least95% concordant calls over all64 planned loci, and zero retained MP36/external ID overlap. This is an empirical descriptive transfer gate, not a conditional statistical guarantee. Each rule retains its own outcome; neither rescues the other.
local_reporting: Every locus and record; size2-4,5-10,11-30; expected label0/1; insertion/deletion; fixed1Mb region; read orientation. Paired source-to-source and rule-to-rule transitions. Preserve contrary preferences within concordant loci, containing sets and intersections. No global score grants local authority.
comparators: Strict consensus0 is a strong frozen simple comparator; median gain must be attributed relative to it. Edlib is a computational distance verification, not an independent biological pipeline benchmark.
limits: Same individual and prior loci; metadata do not establish independent DNA preparation. Same laboratory/platform and benchmark assumptions may persist. No editing-efficacy or same-fragment HEK3/CFTR truth claim.
runtime: CPU Colab CLI, eight-locus atomic checkpoint batches, persist outputs after each batch to Drive.24h wall-clock ceiling, no large local downloads. Independent distance/extraction and identifier audits before final adjudication. Manuscripts private.
